sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a hall inside a drum of rust-red iron, great iron pistons standing in a row of cylinders rising toward a gantry high on the far wall, a crank wheel by the floor driving them. A stone ball has just been rolled out of the crank wheel's teeth into a groove beside it, and the pistons have begun to rise and fall out of step like steps moving. High by the way in a valve with a carved eye hisses steam. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack jumps onto the first rising piston, dwarfed by the engine; on the gantry another ball waits at the head of a groove. Riveted plates banded in blue-grey, a cool shaft of daylight from a ring window. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, rust red iron, blue-grey bands, brass, steam white, cool teal daylight, deep umber shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
